target.title: fix(whatsapp): bound reconnect catch-up replies
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

WhatsApp messages delivered by Baileys as offline `append` events immediately after a reconnect were always treated as stale startup history, so recently missed messages could be marked read without reaching auto-reply.

Refs #50093.

## Why This Change Was Made

The rebuilt patch widens append admission only after reconnecting a recently active listener. The rolling history cutoff is capped by the existing inbound message-ID dedupe lifetime, expires back to the normal short stale-history guard, and remains disabled on initial startup.

This intentionally covers only catch-up messages that Baileys delivers to OpenClaw. It does not claim provider-side backfill when WhatsApp emits no event.

## User Impact

Recently missed WhatsApp messages that arrive as reconnect catch-up events can be delivered and auto-replied to without reopening stale startup history or allowing old replayed messages outside dedupe protection.

## Evidence

- Focused append-upsert suite: 9 passed, 75 skipped.
- Reconnect-controller suite: 28 passed.
- Touched-file formatting and diff checks passed.
- Fresh Codex autoreview: clean after two accepted replay/steady-state fixes.
- Exact prepared head: `7f44d1cff22b1ba23893863331cb990961e4e67b`.
- Remote changed gate passed: Testbox `tbx_01kws3zp6epsjewj1rmywh15n5`, Actions run `28740759771`.
- Exact-head hosted CI pending after final mainline sync.
